note: The rooftop hammam (zone of R_hotel_03): turquoise mosaics, star skylights, marble fountain basin. Everyone wears thick bathrobes or uniforms. Feminine LEFT: nurse owl pouring tea for a guest (hospitalité), hedgehog with ledger and abacus (hôtellerie). Masculine RIGHT: attendant handing a towel to an old lady in a turban towel, 'Ah, ma'am!' (hammam), hotelier with a ring of keys whispering to a guest (hôtelier), guest on the telephone with a bluebird perched on it (récepteur). Arched door (left) -> back to the roof terrace. Painted 2026-10-22.
